Class 3A playoff preview: Massac County in Opening Round
Massac County travels to Roxana in a Class 3A Opening Round game this weekend, and according to our projections, Roxana will win 33-21.
Massac County travels to Roxana in a Class 3A Opening Round game this weekend, and according to our projections, Roxana will win 33-21.
The top eight seeds in each of the North and South brackets of the 48-team Class 3A field have byes in the Opening Round, and the other 32 teams play Friday and Saturday, Oct. 23-24.
Winners advance to the First Round on Saturday, Oct. 31.
We call a game competitive if our projection has it decided by 10 points or fewer and a blowout if the margin is 21 points or more.
Opening Round schedule and predictions
Saturday, Oct. 24
- 2 p.m.: South: No. 17 Massac County (6-3) at No. 16 Roxana (6-3) (Roxana 33, Massac County 21)
Game Capsules
No. 17 Massac County (6-3) at No. 16 Roxana (6-3)
Massac County travels to Roxana in the Class 3A Opening Round, and the winner plays at No. 1 Hillsboro (9-0) in the First Round.
Kickoff is 2 p.m. Saturday.
#17 Massac County (6-3)
Massac County (6-3) is the No. 17 seed in the 48-team Class 3A field and visits No. 16 Roxana in the Opening Round.
Massac County went 6-3 overall and 3-2 in Southern Illinois River-to-River (Ohio), scoring 219 points and allowing 186, an average margin of +3.7 a game.
Massac County went 4-5 and missed the playoffs last season. Massac County has not reached the playoffs in the last 10 seasons.

Anna-Jonesboro (1-8) 34-6; Def. Murphysboro (1-8) 17-14; Lost to Harrisburg (5-4) 35-0; Def. Herrin (1-8) 20-0; Lost to Carterville (9-0) 36-3; Def. Salem (5-4) 35-27; Def. Pinckneyville (0-9) 54-20.
Best Win: Def. Salem (5-4) 35-27 (Week 8)

Location: Roxana

Prediction: Roxana 33, Massac County 21 (Roxana has a 70% chance to win, according to our model).
